verdict.rationale: Increase is a banking API platform with a dashboard, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows no built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt file, OpenAPI spec, CLI and dashboard are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an in-product AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
